          toolchain: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.rust }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1
        with:
          node-version: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.node }}
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json
      - name: Install mutation test tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2.88.1
        with:
          tool: cargo-mutants@27.1.0,cargo-nextest@0.9.150
      - name: Download exact mutation plan
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.artifact_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/mutation-plan
      - name: Prepare hosted Linux build storage
        id: runner_storage
        shell: bash
        run: sudo --preserve-env=GITHUB_ACTIONS,RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT,RUNNER_OS "$(command -v node)" scripts/ci/runner-storage.mjs --prepare | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/runner-storage.json"
      - name: Preserve runner storage measurements
        if: always() && steps.runner_storage.outcome == 'success'
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: runner-storage-${{ github.job }}-${{ strategy.job-index || 0 }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/runner-storage.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Prepare Ubuntu archive source
        shell: bash
        run: sudo --preserve-env=GITHUB_ACTIONS,RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT,RUNNER_OS "$(command -v node)" scripts/ci/ubuntu-apt-source.mjs
      - name: Install Tauri system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libgtk-3-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf
      - name: Cache mutation build
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          save-if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
          workspaces: '.'
          # Equivalent to the original key=mutants plus job=mutants prefix.
          shared-key: mutants-mutants
      - name: Build frontend
        working-directory: frontend
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build
      - name: Execute and seal complete baseline
        id: baseline
        working-directory: src-tauri
        run: node ../scripts/release/run-mutants.mjs --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/mutation-plan" "$RUNNER_TEMP/mutation-baseline"
      - name: Preserve real baseline evidence
        id: upload
        if: always() && (steps.baseline.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outcome == 'failure')
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: mutation-baseline-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/mutation-baseline/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  mutants:
    name: Workspace mutation sample (${{ matrix.worker }})
    needs: [plan, baseline]
    if: needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.plan.outputs.selected != '0' && needs.baseline.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 270
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 8
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    env:
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '1'
      MUTATION_PLAN_DIGEST: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.digest }}
      MUTATION_PLAN_ATTEMPT: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.producer_attempt }}
      MUTATION_BASELINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.baseline.outputs.digest }}
      MUTATION_BASELINE_ATTEMPT: ${{ needs.baseline.outputs.producer_attempt }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.rust }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1
        with:
          node-version: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.node }}
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json
      - name: Install mutation test tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2.88.1
        with:
          tool: cargo-mutants@27.1.0,cargo-nextest@0.9.150
      - name: Download exact mutation plan
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.artifact_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/mutation-plan
      - name: Prepare hosted Linux build storage
        id: runner_storage
        shell: bash
        run: sudo --preserve-env=GITHUB_ACTIONS,RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT,RUNNER_OS "$(command -v node)" scripts/ci/runner-storage.mjs --prepare | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/runner-storage.json"
      - name: Preserve runner storage measurements
        if: always() && steps.runner_storage.outcome == 'success'
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: runner-storage-${{ github.job }}-${{ strategy.job-index || 0 }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/runner-storage.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Prepare Ubuntu archive source
        shell: bash
        run: sudo --preserve-env=GITHUB_ACTIONS,RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT,RUNNER_OS "$(command -v node)" scripts/ci/ubuntu-apt-source.mjs
      - name: Install Tauri system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libgtk-3-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf
      - name: Cache mutation build
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          # The baseline is the sole trusted writer of the existing shared key.
          save-if: 'false'
          workspaces: '.'
          key: mutants
      - name: Build frontend
        working-directory: frontend
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build
      - name: Download exact successful baseline producer artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ needs.baseline.outputs.artifact_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/mutation-baseline
      - name: Mutants (workspace sample)
        id: execution
        working-directory: src-tauri
        env:
          MUTATION_WORKER: ${{ matrix.worker }}
        run: node ../scripts/release/run-mutants.mjs --worker "$RUNNER_TEMP/mutation-plan" "$RUNNER_TEMP/mutation-baseline" "$RUNNER_TEMP/mutation-worker" "$MUTATION_WORKER"
      - name: Upload mutants report
        if: always() && (steps.execution.outcome == 'success' || steps.execution.outcome == 'failure')
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: mutants-report-${{ matrix.worker }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/mutation-worker/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  mutation-gate:
    name: mutants
    needs: [runner-contract, plan, baseline, mutants]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Linux-only mutation tool owner; acknowledge retirement only after ECHILD.

Tools may create their own process groups. Kernel adoption, rather than a process
name or ancestry scan, gives this single-threaded owner authority over orphans.
"""
import ctypes
import json
import os
import signal
import sys
import time


def main():
    if sys.platform != "linux" or len(sys.argv) < 5 or sys.argv[3] != "--":
        raise RuntimeError("Linux owner requires ACK NONCE -- COMMAND")
    acknowledgement, nonce = sys.argv[1:3]
    if len(nonce) != 64 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in nonce):
        raise RuntimeError("invalid retirement nonce")
    if os.path.lexists(acknowledgement) or os.path.lexists(acknowledgement + ".partial"):
        raise RuntimeError("retirement acknowledgement must be new")
    libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    if libc.prctl(36, 1, 0, 0, 0) != 0:  # PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER
        raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), "cannot establish child subreaper")
    flag = ctypes.c_int()
    if libc.prctl(37, ctypes.byref(flag), 0, 0, 0) != 0 or flag.value != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("child subreaper verification failed")
    stopping = False

    def stop(_number, _frame):
        nonlocal stopping
        stopping = True

    signal.signal(signal.SIGCHLD, signal.SIG_DFL)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop)
    # Reject unsupported hosts before admitting tool work.
    if not callable(getattr(signal, "pidfd_send_signal", None)):
        raise RuntimeError("Python pidfd signalling unavailable")
    with open("/proc/thread-self/children", encoding="ascii") as stream:
        stream.read()
    probe = os.pidfd_open(os.getpid())
    try:
        try:
            os.waitid(os.P_PIDFD, probe, os.WEXITED | os.WNOWAIT | os.WNOHANG)
        except ChildProcessError:
            pass  # A process is not its own child; the operation is supported.
    finally:
        os.close(probe)
    # No Popen object/destructor or SIGCHLD autoreaper may consume child status.
    leader = os.posix_spawnp(sys.argv[4], sys.argv[4:], os.environ, setsid=True)
    leader_fd = os.pidfd_open(leader)
    leader_status = None
    retirement_started = None
    forwarded = False
    try:
        while True:
            absent = False
            while True:
                try:
                    pid, status = os.waitpid(-1, os.WNOHANG)
                except ChildProcessError:
                    absent = True  # ONLY ECHILD proves no live/adopted children.
                    break
                if pid == 0:
                    break  # A child remains; proc enumeration is not proof.
                if pid == leader:
                    leader_status = status
            if absent:
                if leader_status is None:
                    raise RuntimeError("leader exit status missing")
                exit_code = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(leader_status)
                exit_code = exit_code if exit_code >= 0 else 128 - exit_code
                with open(acknowledgement + ".partial", "x", encoding="utf8") as stream:
                    json.dump({"schema": 1, "nonce": nonce, "retired": True,
                               "exitCode": exit_code}, stream)
                    stream.write("\n")
                    stream.flush()
                    os.fsync(stream.fileno())
                os.replace(acknowledgement + ".partial", acknowledgement)
                return exit_code
            now = time.monotonic()
            if stopping or leader_status is not None:
                if retirement_started is None:
                    retirement_started = now
                if stopping and not forwarded:
                    # The pinned leader forwards to its tool-owned groups and
                    # gets seven seconds for Nextest's five-second grace and
                    # cargo-mutants' source restoration before forced cleanup.
                    try:
                        signal.pidfd_send_signal(leader_fd, signal.SIGTERM)
                    except ProcessLookupError:
                        pass
                    forwarded = True
                if now - retirement_started >= 17:
                    raise RuntimeError("kernel child retirement deadline exceeded")
                if now - retirement_started >= 7:
                    with open("/proc/thread-self/children", encoding="ascii") as stream:
                        candidates = [int(value) for value in stream.read().split()]
                    for candidate in candidates:
                        try:
                            descriptor = os.pidfd_open(candidate)
                        except ProcessLookupError:
                            continue
                        try:
                            # A pidfd pins identity; waitid separately proves
                            # current DIRECT-child authority. Never signal a
                            # candidate based merely on proc/PID membership.
                            try:
                                os.waitid(os.P_PIDFD, descriptor,
                                          os.WEXITED | os.WNOWAIT | os.WNOHANG)
                            except ChildProcessError:
                                continue
                            try:
                                signal.pidfd_send_signal(descriptor, signal.SIGKILL)
                            except ProcessLookupError:
                                pass
                        finally:
                            os.close(descriptor)
            time.sleep(0.025)
    finally:
        os.close(leader_fd)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        sys.exit(main())
    except Exception as error:
        print(f"mutation process retirement unverified: {error}", file=sys.stderr)

"""Linux-only mutation tool owner; acknowledge retirement only after ECHILD.

Tools may create their own process groups. Kernel adoption, rather than a process
name or ancestry scan, gives this single-threaded owner authority over orphans.
"""
import ctypes
import json
import os
import signal
import sys
import time


def main():
    if sys.platform != "linux" or len(sys.argv) < 5 or sys.argv[3] != "--":
        raise RuntimeError("Linux owner requires ACK NONCE -- COMMAND")
    acknowledgement, nonce = sys.argv[1:3]
    if len(nonce) != 64 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in nonce):
        raise RuntimeError("invalid retirement nonce")
    if os.path.lexists(acknowledgement) or os.path.lexists(acknowledgement + ".partial"):
        raise RuntimeError("retirement acknowledgement must be new")
    libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    if libc.prctl(36, 1, 0, 0, 0) != 0:  # PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER
        raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), "cannot establish child subreaper")
    flag = ctypes.c_int()
    if libc.prctl(37, ctypes.byref(flag), 0, 0, 0) != 0 or flag.value != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("child subreaper verification failed")
    stopping = False

    def stop(_number, _frame):
        nonlocal stopping
        stopping = True

    signal.signal(signal.SIGCHLD, signal.SIG_DFL)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop)
    # Reject unsupported hosts before admitting tool work.
    if not callable(getattr(signal, "pidfd_send_signal", None)):
        raise RuntimeError("Python pidfd signalling unavailable")
    with open("/proc/thread-self/children", encoding="ascii") as stream:
        stream.read()
    probe = os.pidfd_open(os.getpid())
    try:
        try:
            os.waitid(os.P_PIDFD, probe, os.WEXITED | os.WNOWAIT | os.WNOHANG)
        except ChildProcessError:
            pass  # A process is not its own child; the operation is supported.
    finally:
        os.close(probe)
    # No Popen object/destructor or SIGCHLD autoreaper may consume child status.
    leader = os.posix_spawnp(sys.argv[4], sys.argv[4:], os.environ, setsid=True)
    leader_fd = os.pidfd_open(leader)
    leader_status = None
    retirement_started = None
    forwarded = False
    try:
        while True:
            absent = False
            while True:
                try:
                    pid, status = os.waitpid(-1, os.WNOHANG)
                except ChildProcessError:
                    absent = True  # ONLY ECHILD proves no live/adopted children.
                    break
                if pid == 0:
                    break  # A child remains; proc enumeration is not proof.
                if pid == leader:
                    leader_status = status
            if absent:
                if leader_status is None:
                    raise RuntimeError("leader exit status missing")
                exit_code = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(leader_status)
                exit_code = exit_code if exit_code >= 0 else 128 - exit_code

                    json.dump({"schema": 1, "nonce": nonce, "retired": True,
                               "exitCode": exit_code}, stream)
                    stream.write("\n")
                    stream.flush()
                    os.fsync(stream.fileno())
                os.replace(acknowledgement + ".partial", acknowledgement)

                    # gets seven seconds for Nextest's five-second grace and
                    # cargo-mutants' source restoration before forced cleanup.

                        signal.pidfd_send_signal(leader_fd, signal.SIGTERM)
                    except ProcessLookupError:

                    raise RuntimeError("kernel child retirement deadline exceeded")
                if now - retirement_started >= 7:
